_comment: Signal type -> outbound play. 'persona' = committee role to lead with. Edit freely; the engine reads this file.

demo_request.angle: They asked. Call within the SLA, confirm the pain in their own words, book the demo.

pricing_page_visit.angle: Evaluating cost now. Lead with ROI / time saved per rep, offer a 15-min pricing walk-through.

champion_job_change.angle: Congratulate, reference past success with us, ask what their first 90 days look like.

funding_round.angle: New money means hiring targets. Show how to ramp new reps faster without adding headcount.

hiring_for_role.angle: The job post names the pain. Quote it and show how teams automate that work instead.

tech_install.angle: Just adopted a tool we integrate with. Offer the integration recipe.

competitor_churn_signal.angle: Unhappy with incumbent. Offer migration plan + side-by-side.

webinar_attended.angle: Reference the session topic, share the recording + one tactical takeaway.

content_download.angle: Low intent alone. Add to nurture unless combined with another signal.

email_reply_positive.angle: Positive reply. Book the meeting today.
